sentences.text: Lake Powell is a reservoir on the Colorado River , straddling the border between Utah and Arizona -LRB- most of it , along with Rainbow Bridge , is in Utah -RRB- .	Utah	Utah	Arizona	Arizona	Colorado River	Colorado River (U.S.)	Rainbow Bridge	Rainbow Bridge National Monument
It is a major vacation spot that around two million people visit every year .
It is the second largest man-made reservoir by maximum water capacity in the United States behind Lake Mead , storing 24,322,069 acre.ft of water when full .	Lake Mead	Lake Mead

However , due to high water withdrawals for human and agricultural consumption , and because of subsequent droughts in the area , Lake Powell is currently larger than Lake Mead in terms of volume of water currently held , depth and surface area .	Lake Mead	Lake Mead

Lake Powell was created by the flooding of Glen Canyon by the Glen Canyon Dam , which also led to the creation of Glen Canyon National Recreation Area , a popular summer destination .	Glen Canyon	Glen Canyon	Glen Canyon Dam	Glen Canyon Dam	Glen Canyon National Recreation Area	Glen Canyon National Recreation Area

The reservoir is named for explorer John Wesley Powell , a one-armed American Civil War veteran who explored the river via three wooden boats in 1869 .	John Wesley Powell	John Wesley Powell	American Civil War	American Civil War
In 1972 , Glen Canyon National Recreation Area was established .	Glen Canyon	Glen Canyon	Glen Canyon National Recreation Area	Glen Canyon National Recreation Area
It is public land managed by the National Park Service , and available to the public for recreational purposes .	National Park Service	National Park Service

It lies in parts of Garfield , Kane , and San Juan counties in southern Utah , and Coconino County in northern Arizona .	Utah	Utah	Arizona	Arizona	Garfield	Garfield County, Utah	Kane	Kane County, Utah	San Juan	San Juan County, Utah	Coconino County	Coconino County, Arizona
The northern limits of the lake extend at least as far as the Hite Crossing Bridge .	Hite Crossing Bridge	Hite Crossing Bridge
A map centered at the confluence of the Escalante River with the Colorado River gives a good view of the extent of the lake .	Colorado River	Colorado River (U.S.)	Escalante River	Escalante River

Lake Powell is a water storage facility for the Upper Basin states of the Colorado River Compact -LRB- Colorado , Utah , Wyoming , and New Mexico -RRB- .	Utah	Utah	Colorado River	Colorado River (U.S.)	Colorado River Compact	Colorado River Compact
The Compact specifies that the Upper Basin states are to provide a minimum annual flow of 7500000 acre.ft to the Lower Basin states -LRB- Arizona , Nevada , and California -RRB- .	Arizona	Arizona
